name: workshop
notes: The workshop is a microscope, not a different world (AD-14): the rates a bot meets here
match configs/default_world.json, so constants derived by stepping through workshop mode
transfer to the world they will run in.
Aligned: resources 23/750 u^2 = 0.0307 vs default 150/4800 = 0.0313; hazards 3/750 = 0.0040
vs default 20/4800 = 0.0042; respawn_delay_ticks 60 in both; and cluster_affinity copied
from default_world for both pools. Clustering matters as much as the count — a bot wandering
among clumped resources meets feast and famine, while a bot in an evenly scattered arena
meets a steady trickle. Global density can match while the local rate a single bot
experiences does not, which is the transfer failure AD-14 exists to prevent.
Recorded divergence that remains, and why:
- Area 750 u^2 vs 4800, and population 1 vs 20. Deliberate — AD-14 permits size and
population to differ; a single bot in a small arena is what makes this a sandbox you
can watch tick by tick. Note this leaves resources-per-bot at 23 here vs 7.5 in
default_world, so constants sensitive to crowding or contention still need care.
- Counts are whole entities, so the densities land within one entity of default_world
rather than exactly on it (23.44 and 3.13 are the unrounded targets).
Before Story 1.0c this arena was 3.2x more hazard-dense, 35% more resource-scarce, respawned
